mappings.heading: Carry definitions through the whole development lifecycle

mappings.websiteHeading: Start from a useful result
mappings.boundary: The demonstrated path is the frozen Login journey, not a complete IDE or deployment service.

mappings.heading: Make processing reusable across delivery channels
mappings.message: Use shared rules for more than one useful output
mappings.websiteHeading: Trust a check you can inspect and repair

mappings.heading: Meet people where their work happens
mappings.message: Put a capability inside the workflow that needs it
mappings.websiteHeading: Follow processing into a view
mappings.boundary: The Login view is not authentication, and provider/host integration remains an explicit contract.

mappings.heading: Let people keep their language and expertise
mappings.message: Begin with the document knowledge people already have
mappings.websiteHeading: Keep your expertise and make one edit
mappings.boundary: Compare 21 named values on the selected inputs; universal syntax interchangeability is not promised.

mappings.heading: Separate processing from data location
mappings.message: Keep representation, location and processing boundaries explicit
mappings.websiteHeading: Choose a host and name the boundaries
mappings.boundary: Adapters handle representation; host resolver/publication interfaces govern access. No live location-swap proof is scheduled.

mappings.heading: Make contracts reusable

mappings.heading: Make effects explicit
mappings.message: Separate a view from the authority to save or act

mappings.boundary: Declarative markup and light DOM do not by themselves grant or confine business actions.

mappings.heading: Make change a normal operation

mappings.websiteHeading: Bring one useful integration
